title: SEC6: TLS-safe mode for hash ops
description: wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() sets g_tls_safe_mode=1, which causes WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH to return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. This is the right design because the hardware-streaming hash path holds state in an open op_fd; WC_ALGO_TYPE_COPY returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (no session-snapshot ioctl), so a software copy of an empty state would produce silently wrong TLS transcript hashes. The alternatives were: (A) replay buffer at O(transcript) memory per hash object — deferred as too expensive; (B) implement a snapshot ioctl — not available in the kernel interface. Returning UNAVAILABLE for hash when in TLS mode eliminates the trap entirely with zero overhead.
